title.narrative: Capacity Building to Foster Competition Project

description.narrative: The project will (i) strengthen the institutional capacity of the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) to foster competition, (ii) establish a cross-government staff development program for competition policy, and (iii) ensure the sustainability of the reforms by establishing an academic center of excellence in competition policy and law.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3878: 29% of contracts awarded and 33% disbursed as of 20 Feb 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: Product market efficiency improved from being ranked 60 out of 140 countries in 2018, to rank 52 out of 141 countries in 2019.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Oct 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52078/52078-001-apfs-en_2.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: (1) Several workshops have been conducted for PCC including workshops on effective drafting of implementation guidelines and strategic use of economic evidence in pleadings, briefs, and position papers, and workshop on dawn raids. The design and delivery of tailored training courses on Competition Law and Economics by the Barcelona School of Economics have been completed. (2) a total of 16 scholars availed of the scholarship program for Phd and master's degree (Male 6, Female 10) and a total of 33 participated in shortterm secondments and nondegree trainings (Male 12, Female 21). (3) Initial work on the research grants award guidelines have been done by the Competition Law and Policy Program of the University of the Philippines.
